orchestrator_requests.what: A position match override (force_pair) reaches the pair table (position_matches.csv, match_method B2_exact_name_override) but the edge is dropped when position ids are assigned: the coexistence (twin) veto compares principal_amount_usd within 2 pct, so an FX move makes a line in another currency with similar USD par look like the better twin of the end row and vetoes the forced edge. 4 of the 21 force_pair overrides of 0001920145 have no effect on position_id in nbgpf (checked on the built position_id by reviewer_nbgpe/r5_overrides.py, not by the log count 'Match overrides applied: 4 rejected, 21 forced'). Not a verification-check bug; it is a shared matching defect, filed under the nearer of the two allowed classes.
orchestrator_requests.why: Verified cause for Northstar (r3_veto.py nbgpe): NOK 118,397 = USD 11,233,645 (2024-09-30) against NOK 118,100 = USD 10,388,537 (2024-12-31) is a ratio of 1.081 > 1.02, while the USD 11,166 line (2024-12-31) is within 1.006 with the same maturity 2029-05-03, so _coexistence_vetoed returns True for the forced NOK -> NOK edge. Because that union never forms, the supplementary B2 stage can join NOK 118,397 to USD 11,166 (SUPP_B2_contested_name_key; its date-uniqueness guard would refuse it if the NOK -> NOK union existed). Skipping overridden pairs in the supplementary stage, as first proposed, would remove the wrong link but leave the NOK chain broken. Same veto drops Spectrum #4 (EUR 7,890 vs the USD 8,464 line) and Solar #21 (AUD 16,301 vs CAD 14,958 / GBP 8,266); Northstar #8 (USD 10,582 -> USD 10,582) is not vetoed itself and did not form; probable cause, unverified: the 1:1 end-row contest with the C_normalized pair USD 11,192 undrawn -> USD 10,582 (which is vetoed). Published rows affected (position_id only; fair value, par, currency and cost unchanged): Northstar NOK 118,694 (2024-06-30) and NOK 118,397 (2024-09-30) in chain bf754a60, which continues on USD 11,166 / 11,139 / 12,353 (2024-12-31 to 2025-06-30); NOK 118,100 (2024-12-31) is a singleton fa0e4812; the NOK chain 15ab8d0c starts only at 2025-03-31; USD 10,582 split 2c317456 (to 2024-09-30) / ac456fd3 (from 2024-12-31); Spectrum EUR term loan split 9d5cd265 (ends 2025-03-31) / 33600f5e (from 2025-06-30); Solar AUD BBSW loan split 78cf2f60 (ends 2025-12-31) / 1fcdaeca (from 2026-03-31). Also unlinked with no override: Spectrum USD 8,468 undrawn (d6275227, ends 2025-03-31) -> USD 8,464 drawn (927c7412, from 2025-06-30), and the Solar CAD 14,958 loan split 0eb25451 (to 2025-06-30) / a986c44e (from 2025-09-30) by the same veto.

The reviewer's exact whole-fund audit (r28_industry_all.py nbgpf, 5,652 rows compared, 288 ambiguous between current and comparative prints and 27 with no printed row not compared) finds exactly these 13.
